subject: dog
scope: Actual source, selected design, and four revision key stills only. No video playback inspected; this is not playback approval.

timed_key_evidence.evidence: The opening key shows a rear/left three-quarter orientation toward the person, with the face turned away and no eye shown. Four leg placements support the long angular body.

The next key resolves into the left-facing stance seen in the source. The elongated wedge muzzle, polygon eye, straight back, and four separated angular legs preserve the selected doodle identity through the view change.
The dog turns toward the viewer with the head lowered and legs foreshortened/overlapped under the torso, matching the source change in stance and view.
The final key faces and advances toward screen right, with four readable legs and a lowered forward muzzle. The bowl and trees remain separate environmental shapes rather than intersecting the body.

protected_strengths: The opening away-facing head distinguishes the first pose from the later left-facing stance.
Long blocklike torso, angular muzzle, polygon eye, and bent angular legs retain the chosen drawing character.
Four-limb support and the later turn remain readable across the sampled views.
limits: Some far-leg contours overlap in the front-facing key; the stills provide readable four-limb construction but cannot establish gait continuity or motion timing.
